$description: The owner's V2 direction beside version 0.2 of this repo, and the merged direction built on the branch v2-direction. Written by the lead on 16 November 2026. 'stronger' says which side wins on that topic: v2, v02 or both.

rows.v02: 68 semantic tokens with names of this repo's own: ground, panel, well, edge.
rows.v2: 308 semantic tokens in the product's own words: text, icon, surface, interactive, border, each with states, plus eleven accent hues, type roles, density and gradients.
rows.merged: V2's names are the public names, unchanged. Engineers and designers already use them.
rows.why: A name nobody else uses is a private language. Version 0.2's names lose.

rows.v02: In the repo's token file. Figma would be checked against code.
rows.v2: In Figma, once. Everything else is generated.
rows.merged: Figma owns names and values. The repo holds an exact snapshot, proved by checksum, and never edits it.
rows.why: Designers change values in Figma; a rule that sends them to a JSON file will be ignored.

rows.topic: What stops a bad value shipping
rows.v02: A script fails the build on any contrast or naming breach, and each rule is proved on a planted fault.
rows.v2: A contrast re-run by hand; failures listed as open items.
rows.merged: Every snapshot passes through the contrast audit, the naming lint and the diff before it becomes CSS. A fix Figma does not hold yet lives in an overrides file with its reason, and the diff tool says when Figma has caught up.
rows.why: 215 of 726 declared pairs fail in the Figma file today. A list of open items does not keep them out of the build.

rows.v02: Every pair passes in light and dark; body text is held to 7 to 1.
rows.v2: Brand text in dark 3.83, accent text in dark as low as 1.3, success and warning text in light about 3.2, placeholder 3.24, bold accent hover 3.32.
rows.merged: 77 alias changes, each the nearest step on the same ramp, bring every declared pair to 4.5 (text) or 3 (icons, control edges, focus). 52 pairs are exempt and say why.
rows.why: WCAG 2.2 AA is the floor in the brief.

rows.v2: border/primary at 1.35 to 1 against the page.
rows.merged: border/primary stays a divider. A new border/strong at 3.05 to 1 or better is the edge of a control, as the naming standard's own example suggests.
rows.why: The edge is the only thing that shows where a field is.

rows.v02: Blue, 108 degrees of hue or more from every status colour.
rows.v2: Pink. In dark the primary fill (pink/600) and the destructive fill (red/600) have the same lightness and chroma and sit 27 degrees of hue apart.
rows.merged: Pink stays: it is the owner's choice. The system stops relying on hue: links are underlined, errors carry an icon and words, a destructive button names its action, and a soft destructive variant differs from the primary in shape as well as colour.
rows.why: The brand is the owner's call; telling pink from red must not depend on colour vision.

rows.v02: Border widths, focus ring, control sizes and durations exist as tokens.
rows.v2: Border widths, motion and elevation are not started; no control height, icon size or scrim.
rows.merged: 22 tokens proposed in the repo under the standard's naming rules, each with a reason, listed for adding to Figma.
rows.why: A button cannot be built from tokens without a height and a focus ring.

rows.merged: V2's scale stays: a dense work tool needs 14. A text field uses 16 where the pointer is a finger, because iOS zooms the page under 16. The 10 pixel roles are flagged for removal.
rows.why: Version 0.2 was sized for a checkout on a phone; the app is a work tool on a desktop as well.

rows.v02: 48 pixels everywhere, 56 for the main action.
rows.merged: 32, 40 and 44, and at least 44 wherever the pointer is a finger.
rows.why: 40 is right for a mouse and small for a thumb.

rows.v02: Ten parts for a checkout and an assistant, in plain HTML and CSS, working with JavaScript off.
rows.v2: Button, Input, Tabs, DropdownMenu, Dialog: the five the app uses most, in React on Radix.
rows.merged: The five, in React on Radix, styled by a stylesheet that needs no framework. Version 0.2's ten stay on main, to re-point at the new tokens next.
rows.why: 235 files in the app use Button. The first five must be the ones engineers reach for.

rows.v02: A Markdown note per part, with markup to copy.
rows.v2: Two rules from Nathan Curtis: map states to data attributes, type every prop.
rows.merged: A JSON spec per component against a schema: anatomy with roles, typed props with defaults, every state as a selector, token-only styles, and requirements that each name their check. The stylesheet, the typed props, the docs and the tests are generated from it.
rows.why: A note can say 'size: med' and nobody notices. A schema cannot.

rows.topic: Proof that a component does what its description says
rows.v02: A browser check of every screen at three widths and at 200 percent text; a checkout completed with scripts off.
rows.merged: A browser runner drives each component into each state the spec lists and compares the rendered colour with the token the spec names; runs axe; presses the keys; measures contrast, size and the focus ring.
rows.why: A story shows a state. It does not fail when the state is wrong.

rows.v02: A grammar enforced by a script.
rows.v2: A written standard with ten rules, and a file that breaks several of them: radius named by height, type roles named small and base, typography prefixes that Tailwind will not pick up, no descriptions.
rows.merged: The owner's standard, enforced by a lint with 18 rules. The 24 places where the Figma file breaks its own standard are listed, not silently renamed.
rows.why: The standard is good. It needs a machine holding the file to it.

rows.v02: 0.2.0 in this repo; an older 0.1.0 archived on a tag.
rows.merged: One number for the whole system, as V2 says. Not 0.1.0 in this repo: that tag is already taken by the archived build. The standard's own table says a rename is a major change and an addition a minor one, which cannot hold if the number never moves.
rows.why: A version that never changes tells an engineer nothing.

rows.merged: Geist, self-hosted, shown with font-display swap so text is never blocked, with the system font behind it. It has no Japanese, Chinese or Korean glyphs; those fall back.
rows.why: The owner's choice, and a real typeface is part of a brand. The cost is one font file.

rows.v2: 86 of 171 colour roles are used by no starred component; 63 gradient variables by none.
rows.merged: Everything is generated for now: the whole token stylesheet is under 5 kilobytes compressed. The report lists every colour token no component uses.
rows.why: Removing the unnecessary is in the brief, but deleting a designer's tokens is not the lead's call.
